exact: zinc potentiation of glycinergic synaptic transmission

definition: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of glycinergic synaptic transmission in the presence of zinc. Glycinergic synaptic transmission is the process of communication from a neuron to another neuron across a synapse using the neurotransmitter glycine.
label: zinc potentiation of synaptic transmission, glycinergic
